notes.title: Plasma Spheres Released
notes.content:
Plasma Spheres has been released on Steam!

Plasma Spheres is an arcade platformer where up to four players can battle it out with plasma, tractor beams, and dozens of power-ups. There are eight different game modes which can be played with both online and local multiplayer. Enable teams to play co-op with your friends against other players or the bots. You can also play locally against the bots in a campaign featuring four difficulties and twenty challenges.

We are excited to play against everyone, and welcome your feedback. Each power-up interacts with others in unique ways and we're sure there are some synergies even we haven't discovered yet. Here are some things we have planned for updates in the future: 

-New Power-ups
-New Courses
-New Game Modes
-Perk System
-Level Editor

See you in the game!
